title: eludite/nuget/credentials
description: Host-to-shell request: a private feed asked for credentials that no credential provider (the NuGet plugin providers found in the plugin folders and NUGET_PLUGIN_PATHS, such as Azure Artifacts') answered, during an `interactive` call. The shell asks the person (brief 0045's dialog pattern) and answers; the host keeps the answer for the session (never written) and passes it on to restores. A `null` result or `canceled` fails the call with `credentials_required`.

operation.description: The shell's id for this call (from 1): eludite/nuget/update notifications and eludite/nuget/credentials requests caused by it carry it, so the shell can route the Package Manager output and know who asked.

url.description: The address that answered 401 (or 407 for a proxy).

host.description: The host (and port) of `url`, as the dialog names it.

isRetry.description: A previous answer for this source was refused.

remember.description: Keep it for the rest of the session (the dialog's "Remember for this session").
